files.name: Landing kit notes
files.body: Keep the hero to one promise. Print the price. One primary button to /shop. Owner name lives in the footer. Do not add a countdown.

files.name: Prompt pack
files.body: Sales: publish catalog, never invent a discount. Support: point to /legal first. Governance: block subscription language. Risk: demo stays default until keys exist.

files.name: First-launch SOP
files.body: 1) Set env vars. 2) Deploy. 3) Hit /api/health. 4) Place one demo order. 5) Turn Stripe on only after a successful demo.

files.name: Sales brief
files.body: Input: catalog + visitor click. Output: checkout.started. Forbidden: changing price, stacking upsells, claiming scarcity that is not real.

files.name: Support brief
files.body: Input: buyer email. Output: policy answer or escalate. Forbidden: promising refunds after download without owner override.

files.name: I/O contract
files.body: Every agent emits an event. No agent reads another agent's internals. Payload is JSON. Secrets stay server-side.

files.name: Decision rights
files.body: Agents decide copy, catalog listing, and demo checkout. Owner decides contracts, large refunds, and live Stripe cutover.

files.name: Incident script
files.body: If /api/health fails for 5 minutes, email the owner. Do not change prices mid-outage. Roll back the last Vercel deploy.

files.name: Owner override
files.body: Override is the support email on /legal. Agents recommend. They do not wire funds or rewrite refund law.
